text:
jaden: Aurora AI dispute on INV-2026-4098. They're showing a $47,203.12 overage for Dedicated in week of 2026-06-02 after an automated EU failover.
priya: I pulled the capacity attribution logs. Looks like traffic shifted to eu-west as expected, but commit attribution replicated to both us-west and eu-west pools for ~3 hours due to a routing-tag bug (ROUTE_TAG-198).
carla-finance: that would double-count reserved commits and artificially inflate burst billing? we need clear numbers before any credit.
tom-ops: here's the allocation snippet from the router audit (sanitized):

```
time,customer,pool,commit_id,requests
2026-06-03T01:02:10Z,AuroraAI,us-west,CMT-1001,82000
2026-06-03T01:02:10Z,AuroraAI,eu-west,CMT-1001,81500
2026-06-03T01:10:00Z,AuroraAI,eu-west,CMT-1001,180000
```

tom-ops: while the actual requests were served out of eu-west, the commit metric was incremented in both pools because the routing service applied the legacy per-region attribution logic in parallel.
evelyn-csm: Aurora provided their own telemetry; they confirm only eu-west answered requests. They're asking for a full reversal plus SLA credit.
carla-finance: preliminary reconciliation: duplicate commit consumption ~163k units. At our committed unit price of $0.18/unit-equivalent for reserved pool allocation (monthly amortized) that maps roughly to $29,340 in misattributed commit cost; invoice total overage is $47,203.12 so leftover $17,863.12 looks like true burst usage (they did have a short spike).
legal: if this is our bug, we should absorb the misattributed commit amount and consider a discretionary SLA credit for the customer relationship. any precedent?
carla-finance: precedent: we issued vendor-recoverable credits for third-party meter issues, but internal infra bugs have been absorbed and sometimes paired with a goodwill SLA credit (typically 5-10% of the monthly invoice for infra-caused disruption).
priya: ops fix for ROUTE_TAG-198 deployed at 2026-06-03T04:45:00Z; routing now canonicalizes commit attribution to the active pool. We'll attach the deploy hash and audit trail.
jaden: CT asked for an itemized note showing credits applied, accounting treatment, and timeline for when the invoice will reflect the change.
carla-finance: propose actions: (1) reverse $29,340 misattributed commit charge (customer AR adj), (2) issue SLA goodwill credit of $5,000, (3) leave $12,863.12 as-is (validated burst). Total credit = $34,340. Accounting entries (provisional):

```
DR Revenue Adjustment 6102: $34,340.00
CR Accounts Receivable 1200: $34,340.00
```

carla-finance: flagging that the SLA goodwill is non-recoverable; commit reversal is internal (not vendor). Need sign-off from finance lead + legal for precedent.
legal: approve language for customer comms and ok to proceed. need a note that this does not set legal precedent for future claims; include standard waiver clause.
evelyn-csm: I'll run the customer message by Aurora. Draft: "We identified an internal routing bug that caused duplicate commit attribution during your failover window. We've reversed the misattributed charges and issued a one-time goodwill credit of $5,000. Your adjusted invoice will reflect these credits within 3 business days. We're sorry for the inconvenience and have patched the issue to prevent recurrence."
carla-finance: fine, but please include the exact invoice line adjustments and the accounting memo attached. Also tag the billing ticket BIL-88213 and attach the router audit and deploy details.
jaden: Aurora replied: "Thanks for the quick fix. We need confirmation of GA-safe SLA targets before renewing. Also request a summary of the root cause and mitigation."
priya: adding action item: ops to produce a 1-page RCA and a short remediation plan for customers (RCA-ID: ROUTE_TAG-198-RCA).
carla-finance: approvals: @carla-finance, @tom-ops, @legal please react with :thumbsup: to authorize provisional adjustment now. We'll mark it as provisional until AR reconciliation posts.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
tom-ops: (reacts) :thumbsup:
legal: (reacts) :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-4098 status -> ADJUSTED (credit $34,340.00) / Ticket: BIL-88213
carla-finance: I'll create GL entries and update the billing ledger. tagging: InternalError/RouteTag/ROUTE_TAG-198. Keep this thread open until final AR posting and customer's confirmation.
evelyn-csm: Aurora acknowledged receipt and will share renewal decision timeline.
priya: I'll follow up with the RCA and the deploy artifact. ops will also add a canary for multi-pool attribution to the monitoring dashboards.
carla-finance: closing action list: Post provisional credit, attach accounting memo, update BIL-88213 with attachments, publish RCA to customer, monitor for similar patterns. Leaving thread open until done.
